example.name: issue_capture
example.scenario: User reports: “The new pipeline editor UI throws when I add a camera fragment.”
example.user_request: Add more context via questions about the error, reproduction steps, and relevant files (webui or backend).

step.approach: Ask: “What are the exact steps to reproduce, and is there an error message?” Outcome: Capture the stack trace and precise buttons clicked.
step.expected_outcome: Precise reproduction steps with any command arguments included.

step.approach: Ask: “Which files or UI tabs touched this area? WebUI frontend, backend endpoint, or shared renderer?” Outcome: User confirms webui/js/main.js and src/main_backend.py are involved.
step.analysis: Document that the failure occurs during WebUI camera fragment addition, with backend log mention.

step.approach: Summarize the problem impact, list the two files, mention follow-ups (logs, repro scripts), and note urgent triage.

example.completion: Issue overview: describe the crash, its impact, and desired fix. Basic file context: list webui/js/main.js and src/main_backend.py. Other related info: reproduction commands, logs to grab, remaining unknowns.

key_takeaways.takeaway: Keep follow-up answers paired with the questions for traceability.
Always verify whether backend logs are needed before closing the conversation.
